mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) reflects a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.0% (50th percentile), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% indicates an aggressive monetary easing policy, which reduces discount rates and stimulates economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a severe economic contraction, which depresses corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% and INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 380,000 (25th percentile) signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and RSAFS < 380000, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 (25th percentile) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 900.0 (25th percentile) reflects a deteriorating housing market, which reduces household wealth and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 900.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 220.0 (75th percentile) indicates accelerating inflation, which prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 380,000 signals a severe demand shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0% and RSAFS < 380000, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal remains below 0.03.
